packs.description: Server pack for Renoir: only the mods that work on the server (Jotunn, Zen.ModLib, ZenUI, ZenHoverItem, QuickStackStore, MultiUserChest, AchievementEnabler, SlopeCombatAssistance, NetworkPerformanceSystem, ValheimCommunityPatch, EquipmentAndQuickSlots and QuickTeleport), same settings as Renoir Client.
